we propose a general analytical expression for PAPR distribution of OFDM systems with arbitrary power allocation strategy.
the PAPR distributions of real OFDM signals are more accurately identified by the proposed analytical expression than that by the previous analytical expression.
the proposed PAPR distribution can be a very useful tool for the design and analysis of various OFDM systems.
